<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/restaurant">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Order" name="Meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Buzzer" name="Buzzer and instructions"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealOrderForChef" name="New meal order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealReady" name="Meal ready"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_BuzzerRing" name="Buzzer rings"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_EmployeeCall" name="Call for guest"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest at service hatch"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MealHandover" name="Meal handover"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Restaurant">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Guest" name="Guest" processRef="Process_Guest"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Employee" name="Employee" processRef="Process_Employee"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Chef" name="Chef" processRef="Process_Chef"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Order" name="Place meal order"
                      sourceRef="Task_GuestPlaceOrder" targetRef="Start_EmployeeOrder"
                      messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Payment" name="Pay for meal"
                      sourceRef="Task_GuestPay" targetRef="Task_EmployeeCollectPayment"
                      messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerHandover" name="Buzzer and instructions"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer"
                      messageRef="Message_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ChefOrder" name="Inform chef of new meal order"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmployeeInformChef" targetRef="Start_ChefOrder"
                      messageRef="Message_MealOrderForChef"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealReady" name="Inform employee meal is ready"
                      sourceRef="Task_ChefInformEmployee" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveReady"
                      messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_BuzzerRing" name="Buzzer rings"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Task_GuestHearBuzzer"
                      messageRef="Message_BuzzerRing"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_EmployeeCall" name="Call for guest"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmployeeCallGuest" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveCall"
                      messageRef="Message_EmployeeCall"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_GuestAtHatch" name="Guest appears at service hatch"
                      sourceRef="Task_GuestArriveAtHatch" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveGuest"
                      messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_MealHandover" name="Hand over meal"
                      sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal" targetRef="Task_GuestPickUpMeal"
                      messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Guest" name="Guest meal process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_GuestHungry" name="Guest feels hungry"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestEnter" name="Enter the restaurant"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestChooseDish" name="Choose a dish from the changing meal range"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestWaitTurn" name="Wait for turn"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GuestPlaceOrder" name="Place meal order" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GuestPay" name="Pay for meal" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer" name="Receive buzzer and instructions" messageRef="Message_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_GuestNotification" name="Wait for notification" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GuestHearBuzzer" name="Hear buzzer ring" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRing"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GuestReceiveCall" name="Receive employee call" messageRef="Message_EmployeeCall"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GuestNotificationMerge" name="Notification received"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_GuestArriveAtHatch" name="Arrive at service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_GuestPickUpMeal" name="Pick up meal" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GuestEat" name="Eat meal"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_GuestMeal" name="Meal eaten"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_1" sourceRef="Start_GuestHungry" targetRef="Task_GuestEnter"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_2" sourceRef="Task_GuestEnter" targetRef="Task_GuestChooseDish"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_3" sourceRef="Task_GuestChooseDish" targetRef="Task_GuestWaitTurn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_4" sourceRef="Task_GuestWaitTurn" targetRef="Task_GuestPlaceOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_5" sourceRef="Task_GuestPlaceOrder" targetRef="Task_GuestPay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_6" sourceRef="Task_GuestPay" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_7" sourceRef="Task_GuestReceiveBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_GuestNotification"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_8" sourceRef="Gateway_GuestNotification" targetRef="Task_GuestHearBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_9" sourceRef="Gateway_GuestNotification" targetRef="Task_GuestReceiveCall"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_10" sourceRef="Task_GuestHearBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_GuestNotificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_11" sourceRef="Task_GuestReceiveCall" targetRef="Gateway_GuestNotificationMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_12" sourceRef="Gateway_GuestNotificationMerge" targetRef="Task_GuestArriveAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_13" sourceRef="Task_GuestArriveAtHatch" targetRef="Task_GuestPickUpMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_14" sourceRef="Task_GuestPickUpMeal" targetRef="Task_GuestEat"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Guest_15" sourceRef="Task_GuestEat" targetRef="End_GuestMeal"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Employee" name="Employee meal service process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_EmployeeOrder" name="New guest order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_EmployeeOrder" messageRef="Message_Order"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeEnterPOS" name="Enter order into POS system"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_EmployeeCollectPayment" name="Collect payment from guest" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EmployeeSetUpBuzzer" name="Set up buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmployeeHandOverBuzzer" name="Hand over buzzer and explain "When the buzzer rings, your dinner is ready"" messageRef="Message_Buzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmployeeInformChef" name="Inform chef of new meal order" messageRef="Message_MealOrderForChef"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_EmployeeReceiveReady" name="Receive notice that meal is ready" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer" name="Set off guest's buzzer" messageRef="Message_BuzzerRing"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_EmployeeWait" name="Wait for guest or five minutes" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_EmployeeReceiveGuest" name="Receive guest at service hatch" messageRef="Message_GuestAtHatch"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_EmployeeFiveMinutes" name="Five minutes pass">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_EmployeeFiveMinutes">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">PT5M</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmployeeCallGuest" name="Call for guest" messageRef="Message_EmployeeCall"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal" name="Hand over meal to guest" messageRef="Message_MealHandover"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_EmployeeServed" name="Meal handed over"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_1" sourceRef="Start_EmployeeOrder" targetRef="Task_EmployeeEnterPOS"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_2" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeEnterPOS" targetRef="Task_EmployeeCollectPayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_3" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeCollectPayment" targetRef="Task_EmployeeSetUpBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_4" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeSetUpBuzzer" targetRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_5" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverBuzzer" targetRef="Task_EmployeeInformChef"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_6" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeInformChef" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_7" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveReady" targetRef="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_8" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeSetOffBuzzer" targetRef="Gateway_EmployeeWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_9" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployeeWait" targetRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_10" sourceRef="Gateway_EmployeeWait" targetRef="Event_EmployeeFiveMinutes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_11" sourceRef="Event_EmployeeFiveMinutes" targetRef="Task_EmployeeCallGuest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_12" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeCallGuest" targetRef="Gateway_EmployeeWait"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_13" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeReceiveGuest" targetRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Employee_14" sourceRef="Task_EmployeeHandOverMeal" targetRef="End_EmployeeServed"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chef" name="Chef meal preparation process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_ChefOrder" name="New meal order received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ChefOrder" messageRef="Message_MealOrderForChef"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChefPrepareMeal" name="Prepare meal"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ChefPlaceMeal" name="Place meal in service hatch"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ChefInformEmployee" name="Inform employee meal is ready in the service hatch" messageRef="Message_MealReady"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ChefMealReady" name="Employee informed"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_1" sourceRef="Start_ChefOrder" targetRef="Task_ChefPrepareMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_2" sourceRef="Task_ChefPrepareMeal" targetRef="Task_ChefPlaceMeal"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_3" sourceRef="Task_ChefPlaceMeal" targetRef="Task_ChefInformEmployee"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Chef_4" sourceRef="Task_ChefInformEmployee" targetRef="End_ChefMealReady"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
